verdict.rationale: Composio's docs say the platform runs the OAuth flow for you: the agent posts a Connect Link, the user signs in, and there is 'no auth UI for you to build.' The flow supports a callback_url and white-labeling, and Composio 'stores and refreshes those credentials' per userID, which covers the hosted OAuth, vaulting and automatic-refresh core of the story. One community report of a failed Instagram connection (400 error) is a single-toolkit failure, not a contradiction of the general capability. A report that a leaked API key exposed live tokens raises vault-security questions but does not disprove encrypted storage. missing for 10: explicit documentation that stored credentials are encrypted at rest, detail on how token refresh works, independent hands-on corroboration of reliable OAuth connections.
